captions.caption: Three children run and joyfully dive into a large pile of autumn leaves in a grassy field, laughing as they bury themselves and emerge, continuing their playful chase.

Three children playfully run and leap through a thick blanket of fallen autumn leaves in a grassy yard, their energetic movements kicking up swirling clouds of foliage as they chase each other near a parked truck.
Three children playfully jump and run through a large pile of fallen leaves in a suburban backyard, with a red pickup truck parked in the driveway and a house in the background.
Children play energetically in the leaf-strewn yard, chasing each other and a ball, while an adult watches from the driveway near parked vehicles and two dogs.

A woman walks across a driveway toward a black car, while two young children play in the leaf-strewn yard. One child runs toward the house, and the other carries a bundle of leaves, suggesting a casual, autumnal day at a suburban home.

A young boy, barefoot and carrying a bundle of autumn leaves, walks across a leaf-strewn yard and driveway. He approaches a girl in a blue shirt who is standing near a bicycle and a toy horse. The girl, holding a small object, appears to be interacting with the boy as they both stand on the concrete driveway in front of a house with parked cars.
Children play energetically in a leaf-covered yard, running and chasing each other near a parked truck, with a dog nearby and a house in the background.
